class.name: ParticleImpactTable
class.brief_description: Picks the impact effect for the surface that was hit.
class.description: Maps surface names (for example [code]concrete[/code], [code]metal[/code], [code]wood[/code], [code]glass[/code], [code]water[/code], [code]flesh[/code]) to [ParticleEffect3D] scenes. A weapon only reports the hit and the table plays the matching effect with its decal and sound: [codeblock] var hit = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query) if hit: impact_table.spawn_from_hit(get_tree().current_scene, hit) [/codeblock] The surface of a collider is found in this order (see [method get_surface]): a [code]surface[/code] metadata on the collider or one of its three nearest ancestors; a [code]surface[/code] metadata on its [PhysicsMaterial], else the material's [member Resource.resource_name]; a node group named like one of the [member effects] keys. Without a match, [member default_effect] is used. Surface names are not case sensitive. Effects are oriented with their +Y axis along the surface normal, as the impact presets of the Particle workspace are authored, and are played with [method ParticleEffect3D.spawn], so they are pooled.

method.name: get_all_effects
method.description: Returns every effect scene of the table, including [member default_effect]. Used by [ParticleLevelSetup] to prewarm them.

method.name: get_effect
method.description: Returns the effect for [param surface], or [member default_effect].

method.name: get_surface
method.description: Returns the surface name of [param collider], or an empty [StringName] when nothing matches.

method.name: get_surface_scale
method.description: Returns the scale [param surface]'s effect is played with: its entry in [member scales], or [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_surface_tint
method.description: Returns the tint [param surface]'s effect is played with: its entry in [member tints], or white.

method.name: set_effect
method.description: Sets the effect for [param surface]; [code]null[/code] removes the entry.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Plays the effect for the surface of [param collider] under [param parent] at [param position], with +Y along [param normal] and moved [member surface_offset] off the surface. The effect is played with the surface's entry in [member tints] and [member scales] multiplied by [param tint] and [param scale] (see [method ParticleEffect3D.spawn]). Returns the effect, or [code]null[/code] if the table has no effect for it.

method.name: spawn_from_hit
method.description: Like [method spawn], using the [code]position[/code], [code]normal[/code] and [code]collider[/code] of a [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.intersect_ray] result.

members.member: Effect for surfaces without an entry in [member effects].
If [code]true[/code], every impact is rotated randomly around the normal, so repeated bullet holes and debris do not look identical.
Optional surface name to [float]: the [member ParticleEffect3D.effect_scale] multiplier used for that surface's effect.
Distance the effect is moved off the surface along the normal.
Optional surface name to [Color]: the [member ParticleEffect3D.tint] multiplier used for that surface's effect, for example one blood effect tinted yellow for an [code]"insect"[/code] surface.
